description: This file defines a compile-time typelist utility with various template metaprogramming features such as size, conversion to tuple, filtering, concatenation, and element access, used for type computations within the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: typelist
classes.description: A template class representing a list of types for compile-time type computations.

classes.name: size
classes.description: Template struct to compute the number of types in a typelist.

classes.name: to_tuple
classes.description: Template struct to convert a typelist to a std::tuple.

classes.name: from_tuple
classes.description: Template struct to create a typelist from a std::tuple.

classes.name: concat
classes.description: Template struct to concatenate multiple typelists into one.

classes.name: filter
classes.description: Template struct to filter types in a typelist based on a type trait condition.

classes.name: count_if
classes.description: Template struct to count types fulfilling a condition in a typelist.

classes.name: contains
classes.description: Template struct to check if a typelist contains a specific type.

classes.name: all
classes.description: Template struct to check if all types in a typelist satisfy a condition.

classes.name: true_for_any_type
classes.description: Template struct to check if any type in a typelist satisfies a condition.

classes.name: map
classes.description: Template struct to map a type trait over a typelist.

classes.name: head
classes.description: Template struct to get the first type in a typelist.

classes.name: head_with_default
classes.description: Template struct to get the first type or default if list is empty.

classes.name: element
classes.description: Template struct to get the N-th type in a typelist.

classes.name: last
classes.description: Template struct to get the last type in a typelist.

classes.name: take
classes.description: Template struct to take the first N types from a typelist.

classes.name: drop
classes.description: Template struct to drop the first N types from a typelist.

classes.name: drop_if_nonempty
classes.description: Template struct to drop N types or return empty if list is smaller.

classes.name: reverse
classes.description: Template struct to reverse a typelist.

classes.name: find_if
classes.description: Template struct to find the index of the first type satisfying a condition.

classes.name: map_types_to_values
classes.description: Template struct to map a function over types to produce a tuple of values.
